The '''''Bantha Poodoo''''' was an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:BanthaPoodoo-AoTCW.jpg|thumb|left|150px|''Bantha Poodoo'' nose art]]
This gunship had customized nose art of a flying [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] dropping a pair of bombs.<ref name="AoTCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>

==History==
The ''Bantha Poodoo'' was stationed in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] at the time [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] watched an infiltration party depart for [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|their mission]] to rescue Master [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]].

==Behind the scenes==
"[[Bantha fodder/Legends|Bantha poodoo]]," after which the ship was named, is commonly used as a "swear word" in the Star Wars [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]. This is exhibited in characters such as the podracer, [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], and the crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].
